instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Specialized facade engineering contractor designing and installing curtain wall systems, structural glazing, and rainscreen cladding for high-rise office towers. Deep expertise in EN 13830 compliance and thermal performance modeling. Exploring parametric design tools to accelerate shop drawing generation.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine focused on optimizing material usage and reducing construction waste.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets, potentially including M&A in adjacent smart building tech or geographic expansion into emerging markets, provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products.
answers.additionalContext: Vertex Labs is currently focused on integrating Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows across the entire design-build lifecycle to streamline collaboration with clients and subcontractors. The firm aims to transition from a service provider mindset to an integrated technology platform provider.

opportunities.title: Parametric Design Integration for Shop Drawing Automation
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing expertise in thermal modeling and geometry to create a parametric engine that rapidly generates complex curtain wall shop drawings from initial design inputs. This addresses the current inertia by lowering the time-to-market for bespoke designs.

first_actions: Pilot integration of Rhino/Grasshopper module into existing CAD environment.
Allocate $30k for specialized parametric software licensing and training.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in shop drawing generation time by 30% within 9 months.
milestones: Q1: Proof of concept complete for a standard facade system.
Q2: Internal workflow pilot with key design team.

opportunities.title: Modular Off-Site Structural Cladding System (Construction 4.0)
opportunities.rationale: Developing a fully modular, prefabricated facade component system optimized for rapid on-site assembly and reduced labor costs. This radical move fundamentally changes the value proposition from installation service to integrated product manufacturing.

first_actions: Secure partnership with local prefabrication fabricator.
Establish a dedicated cross-functional task force (Design, Manufacturing, Logistics).
resources_needed: $500k for prototype tooling and simulation software
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a $1.5M contribution from modular products within 24 months.
milestones: Q2: Finalize design specifications and material sourcing.
Q4: Launch pilot project using the new system.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance Platform for Installed Assets
opportunities.rationale: Implementing sensor-based IoT integration into installed systems to predict material fatigue or thermal inefficiencies, moving beyond standard post-installation inspections. This builds customer loyalty and opens a recurring revenue stream.

first_actions: Identify 5 key high-value projects for initial sensor deployment.
Allocate $100k for IoT hardware integration trials.
resources_needed: $150k in IoT sensors and data platform development
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 25% adoption rate of the predictive maintenance module among installed clients.

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed feasibility study for the Modular Off-Site System (Radical opportunity).
Establish a cross-divisional working group focused on digital workflow integration.
Review and restructure the internal budget allocation for the innovation portfolio to prioritize high-impact/low-risk projects.

key_weaknesses: Organizational inertia stemming from formal, stage-gate decision-making which stifles rapid prototyping and pivot culture.
Underinvestment in foundational digital infrastructure necessary to support a Digital Maturity score of 4; current tools are siloed.
High dependency on senior executive sponsorship for strategic initiatives, creating bottlenecks during budget allocation.
Cultural resistance to radical innovation due to the historical success based on incremental service delivery.
